sentences: `v_fmamk_f32`/`v_madmk_f32` are D = S0 × K + S1 and `v_fmaak_f32`/`v_madak_f32` are D = S0 × S1 + K, K being the 32-bit literal.
LLVM prints them `vdst, src0, K, vsrc1` and `vdst, src0, vsrc1, K`, so in print order all four are a[1] × a[2] + a[3] (fused for fmamk/fmaak).
**Until 2026-11-21 fmamk and madmk computed S0 × S1 + K.** Source: RDNA2 ISA (V_FMAMK_F32, V_MADMK_F32) and the operand fields of the llvm-mc encoding.

Checked by `tests/semantic` and GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/ps_fma_literal.asm` on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (Linux, driver 620.70.06): 4096/4096 pixels exact, and 4096/4096 differ with the old translator.
